title: Term 3 and 4 Examination
instructions: This paper covers the work of Terms 3 and 4.
This question paper consists of 3 questions. Answer ALL the questions.
Read each question carefully before you answer it.

questions.prompt: In which country is Macbeth set?
Which king does Macbeth murder?
The witches say Macbeth is safe until…
Who escapes when Banquo is murdered?
Banquo is a foil to Macbeth because he does not act on the witches' prophecy.
Match each quotation to its speaker.

pairs.left: 'Fair is foul, and foul is fair'
'Is this a dagger which I see before me'
Was 'untimely ripp'd' from his mother's womb

questions.prompt: Contrast Lady Macbeth in Act 1 with Lady Macbeth in Act 5.
questions.memo:
✓ Act 1: ambitious, ruthless, in control, persuades Macbeth (1)
✓ Act 5: tormented by guilt, sleepwalking, broken (1)
✓ This shows the destructive effect of guilt and her complete reversal (1)

sections.title: QUESTION 2: Essay Writing: Discursive, Argumentative and Reflective

questions.prompt: What is the usual length of a Grade 11 HL essay?
Which essay type explores both sides fairly?
Which essay type focuses on personal insight and growth?
Mentioning a counter-argument always weakens an argumentative essay.
Match each discourse marker to its function.
Improve the vocabulary: 'The new law is really bad for poor people.'
questions.memo: ✓✓ e.g. 'The new legislation is detrimental to low-income households.' (precise, formal vocabulary) (2)

questions.prompt: Why should a reflective essay not simply tell a story?
questions.memo:
✓ The focus is on insight/meaning, not events (1)
✓ The writer must show what was learnt or how they changed (1)

questions.prompt: Write an introduction (2–3 sentences) for a discursive essay on 'Should matric exams be abolished?'
questions.memo:
✓ Introduces the issue engagingly (1)
✓ Indicates that both sides will be considered (1)
✓ Neutral, formal register (1)

sections.title: QUESTION 3: Transactional Writing: Applications, Reports and Speeches

questions.prompt: What is the usual length of a Grade 11 HL transactional text?
Which section of a report explains how information was gathered?
A good review should reveal the ending of a film.
A CV should be clear and may be written in point form.
Match each report section to its content.

pairs.right: Who asked for the report and why

questions.prompt: Name THREE things the body of a letter of application should include.
questions.memo: Any three: ✓ reference to the advertisement ✓ the position applied for ✓ relevant skills/experience ✓ why you are suitable ✓ mention of the attached CV ✓ request for an interview (3)

questions.prompt: Write an engaging opening for a speech on bullying to your school assembly.
questions.memo:
✓ Correct address of the audience (1)
✓ An effective hook, e.g. a question, statistic or anecdote (1)
